description: Run a statistical query against an Iceland statistics table — specify dimension filters to slice data by year, unit, and other indicators. Returns JSON-stat2 format with labeled dimensions and numeric values. Always call iceland-statistics.table_metadata first to discover valid dimension codes and value codes (often Icelandic words, e.g. 'Ár' for year). Example: population 1 January (Eining='0'), 3 most recent years (Ár filter='top' values=['3']). Data: px.hagstofa.is, no auth required, CC BY 4.0 (Statistics Iceland).

query.description: Array of dimension filters. Each filter selects which values to include for one dimension. Example: [{code:'Ár',selection:{filter:'top',values:['3']}}, {code:'Eining',selection:{filter:'item',values:['0']}}]. Response is JSON-stat2 format with dimension labels and numeric values array.

items.description: Filter for one dimension (variable) in the table.

code.description: Dimension code from iceland-statistics.table_metadata variables[].code. Examples: 'Ár' (year), 'Eining' (unit). Dimension codes are frequently Icelandic words with non-ASCII characters — copy them exactly as returned by table_metadata.

filter.description: Filter type. Common values: 'item' (select by exact code), 'top' (select N most recent — use with time dimensions like 'Ár'), 'all' (all values). Use the valueSet codes from metadata.

values.description: Array of value codes to select. Get valid codes from iceland-statistics.table_metadata variables[].values. For filter='item': list codes like ['0']. For filter='top': list count like ['3'] (3 most recent years). For filter='all': use ['*'].

table_path.description: Full path to the leaf table to query — same as iceland-statistics.table_metadata table_path. Example: 'Ibuar/mannfjoldi/1_yfirlit/yfirlit_mannfjolda/MAN00000.px'.

name: iceland-statistics.series.table_query

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Iceland Statistics Table Query
